QUOTE: **`programs/ssl/ssl_server2.c:8` and `programs/ssl/ssl_client2.c:8`** define it at the top of the file, before `ssl_test_lib.h`. These test and demo programs are the only ones that opt out directly. They reach into SSL context internals, which is the case the `ssl.h` warning discourages.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that example programs (ssl_server2/ssl_client2) define MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS themselves to reach into SSL internals past the public API.
